purpose: Q-L1-14 Pocket PS1 top: hash-pinned edits of copies of Pocket/core.sflp (HEAD), Pocket/core_top.v and view_ram_ctrl.sflp; generated interfaces/shims; pinned untracked inputs. Applied by tools/pocket/prepare_ps1_project.py; upstream files are never edited.

fixes.why: author build-dir include path; the private sram_ctrl.h is replaced by the generated sram_ctrl_sfl.h interface of the Pocket/rtl/sram_ctrl.sv shim
author build-dir include path; vjtag_uart.h is copied next to the prepared sources
instance type renamed to the shim around Pocket/rtl/sram_ctrl.sv (whose port names differ from the SFL terminals)
milestone 1 must include sound; upstream Pocket ties the SPU off

fixes.why: export the SPU mix (PlayStation_core voice_L/R) so the SPU is observable and reaches I2S (docs/POCKET_AUDIO_OUT.md)

restore the commented SPU memory requests on the current sdram_read/sdram_write terminals (sdram_read_L/sdram_write_L no longer exist); the old base 0b000100 overlaps VRAM in the 25-bit map, so 0b0000110 is used
restore the commented SPU memory read data/ack path
private RAM header replaced by the generated shim interface
instance type renamed to the shim around Pocket/rtl/ram_320x240x15_dp.sv
the replacement controller takes commands in the core clock domain
fixes.new: synch_3 s3(ram1_word_wr, word_wr_s, clk_50, word_wr_r); // Q-L1-14: adapter command side runs on clk_50

// Q-L1-14: the author's private controller is replaced by Pocket/rtl/sdram128_burstn_adapter.sv
	sdram128_burstn_adapter sdram_ctrl_inst (
		.clk(clk_50), .clk2x(dram_ctrl_clk), .clk2x_90(dram_clk_90),
		.p_reset(~pll_core_locked),
		.write(sdram_write), .adrs(sdram_adrs), .din(sdram_din),
		.enable(sdram_enable), .burst(sdram_burst), .read(sdram_read),
		.dout(sdram_dout), .manual_refresh(1'b0), .refresh_go(1'b0),
		.ack(sdram_ack_100), .dropped(), .stray(),
		.sdram_a(dram_a), .sdram_ba(dram_ba), .sdram_ras_n(dram_ras_n),
		.sdram_cas_n(dram_cas_n), .sdram_we_n(dram_we_n), .sdram_cke(dram_cke),
		.sdram_dm(dram_dqm), .sdram_dq(dram_dq), .sdram_clock(dram_clk)
	);
